entities.name: Zone identity calculation
entities.description: Procedure for UE to determine zone identity using configured parameters and UE location coordinates.

entities.name: Zone identity
entities.description: Identity of the zone in which the UE is located, calculated using specific formulae.

entities.name: sl-ZoneConfig
entities.description: Configuration parameter that must be configured for zone identity calculation to occur.

entities.name: sl-ZoneLength
entities.description: Parameter L included in sl-ZoneConfig, used in zone identity calculation formulae.

entities.name: Longitude distance (x)
entities.description: Geodesic distance in longitude between UE's current location and geographical coordinates (0, 0) according to WGS84 model, expressed in meters.

entities.name: Latitude distance (y)
entities.description: Geodesic distance in latitude between UE's current location and geographical coordinates (0, 0) according to WGS84 model, expressed in meters.

entities.name: sl-ZoneConfig configured
entities.description: Condition that sl-ZoneConfig is configured, which enables zone identity calculation.

relations.description: Zone identity calculation procedure requires that sl-ZoneConfig is configured.
